title: The Gentle Creeper • Mayflower Studios
tagline: A non-exploding creeper who just wanted a friend.

heroTiles.title: 🤍 Adds a Gentle Variant
heroTiles.body: Vanilla creepers are untouched — this mod introduces an additional creeper type that’s peaceful by nature.

heroTiles.title: 🌿 Cozy Encounters, Same Danger
heroTiles.body: You can still get classic creepers… but sometimes you’ll meet one that just wants to exist near you.

heroTiles.title: ✨ Surprise Friend Energy
heroTiles.body: A rare “wait… it’s not exploding?” moment that turns fear into a little bit of wholesome.

descriptionHtml: The Gentle Creeper doesn’t remove or replace anything — it adds a brand new creeper variant that’s… kind.
Vanilla creepers still behave exactly like vanilla creepers. This mod simply gives the world a chance to spawn a gentler green friend alongside the usual chaos.
It’s perfect for cozy playthroughs and servers that want occasional wholesome moments without losing Minecraft’s danger.
Sometimes you get a jumpscare. Sometimes you get a little creature that just stands there like: “hi.”

featureCards.title: ✅ Vanilla Creepers Unchanged
featureCards.body: The original creeper remains 100% normal — same AI, same threat, same boom.

featureCards.title: 🧸 New Gentle Creeper Variant
featureCards.body: Adds an additional creeper type with calmer behavior and a more peaceful vibe.

featureCards.title: 🎲 Naturally Spawns In-World
featureCards.body: The gentle variant can appear alongside regular creepers, making encounters feel fresh and unpredictable.

featureCards.title: 🌙 Cozy Without “Peaceful Mode”
featureCards.body: Keeps the risk of survival intact — just adds occasional softness to the night.

install.calloutBody: Keep client and server versions in sync for consistent behavior.
install.stepsCode:
1) Install Forge (matching your Minecraft version)
2) Drop The Gentle Creeper into /mods
3) Launch once to generate config
4) Restart after config changes
